Balanced gap audit: refusal off 6/6, on 6/6; enabled repeat 2 refused one plan, replanned and arrived. Both arms include the velocity repair; no speed or mortality-rate delta established. Adjacent navigation 30/30; active-Task/crafting/dodge 27/27; identical-entry portal replays 6/6 without deaths or new lava entries, all at 29-30 FPS. Recordings reviewed and cleanup passed. Gap clips show rebuilt arena runs. Earlier casting deaths, the original full59 stall and the water shelter hold remain open.
